description: This file defines the SaveNationalityController class which manages the behavior of nationality-related data in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends a base controller and prepares Vue.js components for rendering based on request parameters.

classes.name: SaveNationalityController
classes.description: Controller handling the save nationality operation, extending AbstractVueController to prepare Vue.js components based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, choosing between 'nationality-edit' and 'nationality-save' based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.

search-terms: Reactively set Vue component based on request
